task.description:
WF-02, step 1 — write the design of REQ-107 (end-to-end tests of the team page in a real headless Chrome, with the scripted test executor only) in docs/design/REQ-107-e2e-team-web.md, by the section "Step 1" of docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md. READ FIRST: the block REQ-107 in docs/requirements.yaml (all 8 criteria; read by id, the file is large); docs/design/REQ-106-e2e-pixel-office.md (section 4.1, the starter change, and section 22 "As built"), docs/design/REQ-105-e2e-picker.md (sections 4 and 21) and docs/design/REQ-104-e2e-chrome-kit.md (the kit API, section 21) — the code in tools/test/e2e/kit/ is the truth, read it too (stand.js, index.js, browser.js, errors.js, runner.js); tools/test/e2e/pixel-office.e2e.js and picker.e2e.js as models of a spec file; decisions/0107 to 0112 (0109 and 0112 with all addenda, especially 0112 О14, О22, О24 and the rule R2-S); docs/quality-bar.md; docs/anti-patterns.md (especially AP-140 to AP-154); the README sections about the team page ("Sai Team — the interface", "The project buttons", "The project page: six questions", "Security", the scripted executor and the scenario format); tools/src/web/ and tools/src/team/ (main.js, the server, the page files, config.js, home.js, executors/scripted.js, executors/claude-cli.js, errors.js, language.js); tools/test/team-web-dom.js and the existing team-web tests; tools/test/fixtures/team/engine-basic.json and README.md of that folder; docs/issues/ISS-0105, ISS-0107, ISS-0108, ISS-0110, ISS-0111 (open kit defects; say whether this design touches them; do not fix them here — if a starter change of this design has to touch the same lines as ISS-0111, name it as an open question with a default).

WHAT THE DESIGN MUST SETTLE: (1) The stand. How the spec starts `node src/web/main.js --port 0 --executor scripted --scenario <file>` through the released starter (stateEnv pair for SAI_TEAM_HOME; the private home <marker>/home is given by the starter, not by the spec). The trap program for SAI_TEAM_CLAUDE_BIN: rule P refuses an absolute path inside the repository in env (decisions/0112, О14) — copy the trap under the temporary root, or propose a pinned exemption with a record. A PATH-like list in env is refused (0112, О22) — say whether the team server needs PATH in env at all. The scenario path is an argument, and rule P applies to arguments too — copy the scenario files under the temporary root, or propose a narrow exemption. SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS is never set, and the child's environment is checked for it. How the positive control of the trap (criterion 1) is run without starting any real program. (2) Re-check every fact the requirement lists as checked on 2026-11-03 (the options of main.js; the printed link line; the mark «тестовый исполнитель»; the six headings; the button names and the pause and stop phrases of README; the confirmation «Не останавливать»; the journal event names of pause, stop and message; «N из M задач»; «Попытка не удалась»; the write key and the Origin check; parseScenario at the start; a delay step in the scenario format; the words of the empty list) on the tag base/E2E107-20261116-01 and write the command, the output and the date; a fact that changed is an open question, not a silent fix. (3) The structure of tools/test/e2e/team-web.e2e.js: one test per criterion 1–7 (stand, create, finish, control, chat, failure, windows) and criterion 8 by commands; each test with its own server and folders; the oracles (the number of tasks read from the scenario file; the journal read from the data folder; the page text read as the visitor reads it, AP-145); the two new scenarios team-slow.json and team-fail.json (shape, checked by the real parseScenario); the second server under a regular file of criterion 6; the new tab of criterion 4 (a missing kit call is a change of the kit with its own tests, not a silent edit). (4) A time budget: criterion 8 says 70000 ms at most; measured runner times of the picker and Pixel Office specs were about 1.2–1.35 times the local ones (handoffs of runs E2E105-20261105-01 and E2E106-20261115-01); state how the file stays under the limit on the runner, measured with a sketch; waits are conditions with limits, not sleeps; do not take a timing of one machine as a fact of another (AP-144, ISS-0103). (5) The replacement table of earlier guard tests: search tools/test/ for tests that read tools/test/e2e or tools/test/fixtures (counts of files, scans of fixtures/team or fixtures/e2e by exec-*.test.js), README rows, package.json scripts; and the shared places (the README table row made by REQ-104, the order check of spec files). (6) Lessons of the last runs to apply from the start: an exemption must be as narrow as its reason and pinned with what it covers; a check read once at the end misses what removes itself before it; a red assertion must not print whole environments or folder listings into the public CI log (0112, О24); a check of absence needs a positive control.

SAFETY RULE R2-T of this run (for every sketch, trial and mutant): (a) never start the team server, the engine, a command of tools/src/team or tools/src/web, a hook of Pixel Office, or any Node program of the project with the real home folder as HOME, or without SAI_TEAM_HOME set to a new folder under the temporary root; (b) never set SAI_TEAM_REAL_RUNS; SAI_TEAM_CLAUDE_BIN always points to a recording trap under the temporary root; never start the real `claude` program; (c) the rule R2-S of decisions/0112 stays: a call that names the real home or the real Pixel Office folder goes only to a spawn that records and throws; never import a program file to read it — read it as text; (d) before and after the work, record whether the folder `.sai-team` exists in the real home (today it does not) and the sha256 of the five files of the real Pixel Office folder (read only), in result.

Check every statement about the current system with a sketch outside the project (a fresh clone of the tag base/E2E107-20261116-01, npm ci, then dummy files) and write the command, the output and the date. The text of the design must hold no absolute machine paths, no temporary paths and no names of other projects of the owner (traces and handoffs-check fail on them). The section about the bar: Q1–Q14 and R1–R3, each "applicable: how" or "not applicable: why". Open questions go as a list О1, О2, … with a default, not settled by a guess.
